profile.name: Brian Kiprotich
profile.headline: Building useful things with code and spatial data.
profile.role: Geospatial Engineer | Software Developer | Energy Utility Analyst | Spatial Data Science
profile.about: Geospatial Engineer, Full-Stack Software Developer and Applied Data Science practitioner with a multidisciplinary background in geospatial engineering, software development, spatial data management and data analytics. Holds a BSc in Geospatial Engineering from the University of Nairobi, a Full-Stack Software Engineering certification from Moringa School and an Applied Data Science certification from WorldQuant University. Experienced in GIS programming, spatial database management and geospatial workflow automation. Practical experience includes supporting electricity infrastructure mapping and Utility Network data migration at Kenya Power, developing GIS dashboards and field data collection solutions, GIS mapping for carbon credit project with Farmlife Health Services ltd.
profile.lead: Geospatial Engineer, Full-Stack Software Developer and Applied Data Science practitioner.

projects.title: TechPoint Point of Sale
projects.description: Designed and developed a full-stack Point of Sale and Inventory Management System to streamline retail operations, sales processing, inventory tracking and business reporting. Implemented backend APIs, PostgreSQL database models and a React-based frontend.

projects.title: Flood Early Warning & Community Alert Platform (Prototype)
projects.description: Prototype concept for turning rainfall and river-level thresholds into neighborhood alerts, with a dashboard for reviewing warning status, affected locations, and response steps. It is not connected to live sensors or operational alert services.

projects.title: GIS Flood Early Warning & Evacuation Mapper (Prototype)
projects.description: Prototype GIS application for mapping forecast flood zones against settlements, roads, public facilities, and evacuation shelters. Designed for scenario review and response planning, not as a live warning service.

projects.title: Urban Flood Susceptibility Analysis (Prototype)
projects.description: Spatial analysis concept combining rainfall, elevation, drainage, land cover, and historical flood records into an area-level susceptibility index. Uses synthetic sample data for demonstration and is not an operational forecast.
